Members

(module scope)

Kind-specific wasm surface for the divider-sheen crate — typed on top of the generic WasmWidget so calls stay checked.

set_colors

Push the hairline + band colors (rgba 0-1, computed style).

(module scope)

Live mount state — the rAF loop + IO gate + the pending-mount flag so a disconnect during the artifact fetch still tears down cleanly.

handle

The widget handle once init resolves (null while pending/failed).

pending

True between mountWebGpuWidget call and its resolution.

failed

True once the mount attempt finished without a widget.

canvas

The overlay canvas (removed on destroy).

io

The IntersectionObserver gating mount + the loop.

raf

Live rAF id, 0 when the loop is idle.

last

Last frame timestamp for dt.

visible

True while the hr is on screen (drives the loop).

dead

True after destroy — every async path short-circuits on it.

pushDividerColors

Resolves the divider's two colors from live CSS vars — the crate never sees var(): --border-color feeds the hairline, --color-accent the traveling band. Alpha is 1 for both (the CSS gradient carries no alpha — the opacity is baked into the stops).

  • @param hr The divider element (vars resolve in its shadow scope).

mirrorDividerBox

Mirrors the <hr>'s box onto the overlay canvas — the canvas is an absolutely-positioned sibling, so it resolves its offsets against the same offsetParent the <hr>'s offset* properties report: copying left/top/width/height lands the overlay pixel-identically. The <hr> stays visibility: hidden (never display: none), so this stays measurable on every resize. Backing size is device px.

  • @param hr The divider element.
  • @param m The live mount state.

tickDivider

The loop tick — dt in seconds; self-schedules while the divider is visible. A widget returning false (stale surface) disarms the loop permanently; the canvas keeps its last frame painted until destroy.

  • @param m The live mount state.

pumpDivider

Starts the loop if it is idle — the IO + visibilitychange paths funnel here so there is exactly one clock at all times.

  • @param m The live mount state.

stopDivider

Stops the loop — IO exit / tab-hidden / destroy paths.

  • @param m The live mount state.

mountDividerSheen

Mounts the divider-sheen widget over an <hr> divider. Returns a disposer that releases the widget, the overlay canvas, the IO, and the rAF — call it from the host component's onDestroy (and call again on re-render: _updateDom swaps the <hr> node, so the old mount's canvas + observer must go with it).

  • @param hr The divider element (aria-hidden already — the canvas
  • @param canvasClass The overlay canvas's class token — the
  • @returns Teardown function; safe to call more than once.
